It's the Don Bluth film that many people don't know how to react to. So, what's Nostalgia Critic's reaction all these years later? Let's take a look at All Dogs Go to Heaven.

Check out our store - https://channelawesome.myshopify.com/

Support this month's charity - https://solvecfs.org/

All Dogs Go to Heaven is a 1989 animated musical fantasy comedy drama film directed by Don Bluth. It stars the voices of Loni Anderson, Judith Barsi (in her final film role), Dom DeLuise, Melba Moore, Charles Nelson Reilly, Burt Reynolds, and Vic Tayback. Set in New Orleans in 1939, it tells the story of Charlie B. Barkin, a German Shepherd mix who is murdered by his former friend, Carface Carruthers.
